linkedin_text:
Most founders lose an entire workday every week to simple, repetitive tasks.

It’s rarely the big strategy work that burns you out. It’s the manual follow-ups, the "what time works for you?" scheduling ping-pong, and copying lead details between apps.

Here are 3 dead-simple automation habits to win back at least 5 hours this week:
1. Auto-tag new leads and trigger an instant welcome note the second they sign up.
2. Use a smart booking link with preset buffer times to kill scheduling back-and-forth.
3. Turn your most frequent customer questions into automated AI-assisted reply templates.

Automation isn't about removing the human touch from your business—it's about clearing the busywork so you can focus on real growth.
